directive.quote: For each, find what now does that job in trillion-rust or trillion-workshop, use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

preserve: The source algorithms, named operations, validation, refusal behavior and account boundaries.
allowed_deltas: Use current public Workshop owners and caller-scoped rows instead of the retired Worker import closure.
Keep missing authenticated host bindings explicit; core preservation is not installed runtime qualification.
Reuse the separately owned tools/brand-kit/read-data/brand-assets.mjs; this contract does not claim its prior source history.
banned_substitutions: Inventing engine operations, granting caller-supplied authority, silently returning empty on unavailable reads, or claiming a callback test proves host installation.
